name: Loca Niru
address: House of Tan Yeok Nee, #02-01, 101 Penang Road, Singapore 238466
lunchNoteZh: 有供應午餐・週五至週六

menus.name: Dinner Experience tasting menu
menus.note: Seasonal menu; six-wine pairing S$188, or sake pairing S$148; no vegetarian, vegan or seafood-free version

bookingOpens: Online through TableCheck, up to 60 days ahead. For a table within 24 hours, or for 12 or more guests, call or message on WhatsApp (+65 8227 4313).
cancellation: Cancelling, changing the date or reducing the party within 72 hours, or not showing up, costs S$150 a person at the counter or in the dining room, or S$1,000 for the private room. Tables are held for 15 minutes; later arrivals may be treated as no-shows.
groups: A private dining room, with a minimum spend (S$1,700++, S$2,500++ or S$5,000++ on the booking page) and a chef's table. Groups of 12 or more book by phone or WhatsApp.
dressCode: Smart casual or lightly formal for men; chic and polished for women. No shorts, singlets or flip-flops.
children: Children aged 12 and over, who must each have the full tasting menu.
duration: Two to three hours. Last seating for dinner is at 8pm.
